subject: Mutual action checkpoint: closeplaybook & go-live owners
messages:
From: Elaine Park <epark@cardiolabs.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: CardioLabs EngOps <engops@cardiolabs.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan v3 — next milestone & launch dates

Hi Lauren / Karthik / Ben —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We've attached our updated MAP (CardioLabs_MAP_v3.xlsx) with the procurement and security gating items filled in. Two quick asks so we can lock the June window:

- Can Redwood confirm a target go-live date by COB next week? CardioLabs is aiming for a production cutover in the week of June 7–13 (primary target: June 10).
- We need a cutover runbook draft and a rollback checklist to circulate to EngOps for signoff.

Can someone own the runbook draft and a short checklist (1 page) for EngOps? Also flag any blockers on the PCI/SOC items in the MAP column — our security team will need explicit evidence for log retention and network isolation.

Attachments: CardioLabs_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Director, Product Operations
CardioLabs
epark@cardiolabs.com

--
(Replying later will help us stitch the timeline before procurement signoff.)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <epark@cardiolabs.com>, CardioLabs EngOps <engops@cardiolabs.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan v3 — next milestone & launch dates

Elaine — thanks for the MAP. We're aligned to support the week of June 7–13; our provisional go-live target is 2027-06-10 (can be moved by 72h if procurement or security needs more time).

Quick plan and owners from our side:
- Cutover runbook (draft): Ben Carter (ben_carter) — deliver draft by 2027-05-20.
- Rollback checklist + canary plan: Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra) — deliver checklist and canary gating criteria by 2027-05-24.
- Security evidence (log retention, KMS config): Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer) — will provide doc links to SOC artifact by 2027-05-21.
- Weekly MAP checkpoint call: Wednesdays 09:00 PT — first checkpoint 2027-05-19.

I'll own the overall closeplaybook and alignment with your EngOps team. Attached is our initial runbook scaffold (cutover_runbook_v2.pdf) — it's deliberately lightweight and focuses on owner tasks, time-boxed validation windows, and rollback triggers.

Please confirm the meeting cadence and owners. If CardioLabs needs a different SLT for the canary window, say so and we'll update.

Attachments: cutover_runbook_v2.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan v3 — next milestone & launch dates (meeting notes)

Folks —

Notes from today's checkpoint (5/18):
- Confirmed provisional go-live: 2027-06-10 (CardioLabs preferred). Redwood will keep a 72-hour buffer for procurement signoff.
- Owners confirmed: Ben = runbook draft; Rishi = rollback/canary; Karthik = SOC evidence + config links.
- Acceptance criteria for canary (high level):
  - 24-hour canary with 10% traffic cap, no P95 latency regressions > 40ms baseline, error rate < 0.1%.
  - Business validation: 3 transactions validated by CardioLabs EngOps during the canary window.
- Cutover cadence:
  - T-48h: final config freeze and validation in staging.
  - T-24h: dry run of rollback procedure in staging environment (owner: Ben).
  - T-0: production cutover (owner: Ben); T+2h: first operational review (owners: Ben + Elaine).

Open items / blockers:
- Procurement: PO and signatures — CardioLabs procurement needs DocuSign link. (ELAINE: please confirm target for PO id.)
- SOC evidence: KMS rotations and full audit log export — I will upload artifacts to the shared Drive by 2027-05-21.
- Metrics hooks: Need confirmation of monitoring endpoints Redwood will push to CardioLabs for alerting. Rishi to propose endpoints by 2027-05-20.

Attachments: lauren_meeting_notes_20270518.txt (plain text meeting notes)

Karthik
VP, Product & Compliance (on the thread as product/compliance lead)
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Quick update from my side:
- Runbook draft is complete and uploaded (cutover_runbook_v2.pdf). Sections covered: pre-cutover validation, T-48/T-24/T-0 steps, rollback run, post-cutover verification.
- Dry-run scheduled in staging on 2027-05-28 09:00 PT — team invited (staging credentials and checklist link to follow).
- Checklist highlight: explicit operator commands for rollback (3 steps), health-check endpoints, and data consistency validation.

Acceptance criteria I want signoff on before T-48h:
1) PO / procurement confirmation (Elaine)
2) Monitoring endpoints & alerting configured (Rishi)
3) Canaries passing for 24h in staging (CardioLabs EngOps + Redwood)

I'll push final version to the shared Drive and drop a DocuSign link for the SOW once procurement confirms PO id.

Attachments: cutover_runbook_v2.pdf (PDF)

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
